CONDITIONALITY_REASON: The lock reproduces in the high-loss cell but the mechanical chain completes correctly in the low-loss control ⇒ the defect is conditional on sustained burst loss, not a structural break of the sample→estimator→pacer chain.

MINIMUM_EVENT_GATE.rule: A fresh-cell root-cause CLASS requires >=4 qualifying lock events (mirrors the DR-CS-2 B6 gate). Below that, the class is reported as INSUFFICIENT-EVENTS and only the deterministic replay mechanism stands.
MINIMUM_EVENT_GATE.verdict: INSUFFICIENT-EVENTS for a firm FRESH-CELL class

REPLAY_SCOPE_LIMIT: RR1 is debugging-only: it establishes MECHANISM, never prevalence or generalization.
lock_predicate: left PreConverge AND max(burst_cap) == SEALED(101) [burst_cap is the exact variable written by TokenBucket::set_burst_cap]
